pages.text: The Card Cloner can be used to 'copy and paste' individual $(l:laserio:cards)Cards$(/l) or entire $(l:laserio:laser_node)Nodes$(/l)!$(br2)When pasting, Cards, $(l:laserio:overclocker_card)Overclockers$(/l) and $(l:laserio:filters)Filters$(/l) will be automatically taken from (or placed back inside) the currently available $(l:laserio:card_holder)Card Holder$(/l). These items will not be pulled out of the player's inventory.

If any of the necessary items are missing, the paste will fail. It will NOT partially paste the settings.$(br2)$(bold)Card cloning$()$(br)From within a Node screen, pickup the Card Cloner (on your cursor) and left-click on a Card to copy its settings.$(br2)Right-click on a Card or an empty Node slot to paste the stored settings.

$(bold)Node cloning$()$(br)While in world, (with the Card Cloner in hand) shift+right-click on a Node to copy it. This copies all of the Node's contents, as well as the $(l:laserio:settings_screen)Network settings$(/l) of the network it belongs to.$(br2)While NOT looking at a Node, right-click can be used to change the paste mode. There are two different paste modes: $(bold)Node contents$() and $(bold)Network settings$().

When the paste mode is set to $(bold)Node contents$(), the Card Cloner will paste only the copied Node's Cards with all their settings (included Overclockers and Filters), $(l:laserio:overclocker_node)Node Overclockers$(/l) and particles setting.$(br2)When the paste mode is set to $(bold)Network settings$(), the Card Cloner will paste only the copied Node network's color, alpha, and wrench alpha values.

While looking at a Node, right-click to paste the copied Node using the previously selected paste mode.$(br2)While NOT looking at a Node, shift+right-click will clear any stored settings from the Card Cloner.
